name: phi-guard
description: Patient-identifier guard: scans text and de-identifies CSV/XLSX files. On hosts without Claude Code hooks the outbound blocking is not automatic.

interface.shortDescription: Find and remove patient identifiers before anything leaves the machine
interface.longDescription: A scanner for patient identifiers in Vietnamese and English text and a de-identifier for data files. In Claude Code a hook blocks identifiers in outbound tool calls; on this host that hook does not run, so scan files yourself before sending or uploading anything.
